sophia: Quick rollup from APAC/EU hybrid-precision sweep — uploaded raw csvs to the runbook. Can someone sanity-check the capacity numbers before I lock the rollout?
liam: which model and workload?
sophia: redwood-infer-7b-v2, 512 token avg seq, mix of chat + few-shot generation (pooled latency + p95).
maya: got it. Did you include KV-cache warm starts?
sophia: yes, tests ran with warm cache and cold-cache for worst-case. Bench script attached in runbook.
bench-bot: AUTO-REPORT: 2026-11-03 14:12 UTC — sweep id: sweep-7241
bench-bot: Summary per region (avg latency / throughput reqs/s @ 512 tokens):
bench-bot: APAC (H100s, fp8): 42ms avg / 18 reqs/s
bench-bot: APAC (H100s, int8): 28ms avg / 26 reqs/s (+45% tokens/s vs fp16)
bench-bot: EU (A100s, bf16): 55ms avg / 13 reqs/s
bench-bot: EU (A100s, int8): 35ms avg / 20 reqs/s
bench-bot: NA (T4, fp16): 120ms avg / 5 reqs/s
amir: those H100 int8 numbers look optimistic — what kernel did you use? fused_matmul_kv?
sophia: used kernel flag: --kernel=fused_kv_relu (newer runtime patch). Full command: ```./bench --model redwood-infer-7b-v2 --precision int8 --kernel fused_kv_relu --seq 512 --concurrency 32```
liam: did you run quality evals for int8 vs fp16/fp8? we need embedding and LM metrics.
sophia: yes: nuggets: lppl/perp delta + embed cosine. Results: fp8 ~<=0.3% perf delta vs bf16 (negligible), int8 on H100 avg perplexity +2.1%, BLEU delta -0.7%, embedding cosine drop -0.003. int8 on A100 perf delta worse: perp +3.9%, BLEU -1.8%, embed cos -0.008.
maya: those embed drops are tiny but might matter for rerank. What's embed pairwise MRR impact?
sophia: rerank MRR down 0.6% on H100-int8, 1.9% on A100-int8. fp8 MRR change <0.1%.
jen: capacity sizing ask: for projected 10k qps global with 40% tail requests (512 tokens), what cluster size?
bench-bot: Estimated capacity (using H100-int8 pools): ~24 H100s (reserved) to sustain 10k qps with target p95 < 200ms. For A100-int8: ~34 A100s. For mixed fp8 fallback (10% fp8 on critical routes): adjust +3 nodes.
amir: kernel note — fused_kv_relu gives 15-18% throughput boost on H100 vs default, but on A100 it's only ~6% and increases mem pressure. Worth flagging in rollout.
liam: ops/infra concern: do we have spare H100s in apac to meet that reserved count?
sophia: not right now; proposed plan: 2-week canary in apac with autoscaling + fallback to EU A100s across regions for overflow.
maya: agree. Also add a small eval suite post-rollout focusing on rerank/embedding probe sets.
sophia: will add: post-rollout probes, kernel toggle flag, and cost estimate. tagging @infra and @ops in runbook.
jen: thumbs — include a rollback threshold: embed cosine drop >0.01 or rerank MRR drop >2% triggers automatic rollback.
sophia: noted, will update runbook and schedule a short sync later today. :thumbsup:
liam: thanks — looks good to me.
jen: thanks all.
